source: Jal Jeevan Mission WQMIS, Format L3: quality affected habitations reported on or after 01/04/2019 (Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti)
method: Read from the public report page, State then each district with any affected habitation, block rows with a non-zero count. The report's query parameters are encrypted in the page, so it is read through the page rather than called directly, and refreshed by hand.
